title: Blanket manufactured in China
text: Blanket manufactured in China. This blanket is very soft and plush. But I was disappointed when I received them to see that they are made in China.  I purchased this through etsy and on the description no mention was made of being made in China.  The description said handmade in South Carolina.  The  shop jonleygifts described the blankets as monograms and initials hand done and wouldn't fade or peel. I'm sure that's true and they initials and names are very well done. But I also check where an item is made and on etsy I always check vintage and handmade and made in USA.  I'm rather disappointed in etsy allowing this misleading description.  I will be more careful and check much more carefully when ordering from etsy in the future.

product_metadata.title: Monogrammed Sherpa Throw Blanket | Personalized Unique Wedding Couple Gifts | Anniversary | Engagement Gift Blanket
description: This super soft, fluffy sherpa throw blanket is the perfect gift for yourself and others! Personalized with custom name monogram makes this blanket the ultimate gift for weddings, anniversaries, housewarming, first home purchases, holidays, birthdays and more! This is the perfect gift for every occasion, any time of year! Personalized gifts take gift giving to the next level.  Rest assured, when ordering from Jonley Gifts, you are ordering from a small business that takes pride in providing top quality handmade products backed by excellent customer service! Purchase with confidence knowing we are a top ranked business across multiple platforms, serving thousands of customers worldwide!
This blanket measures 50x60”. It’s the ideal size for snuggling and makes the perfect accent for your couch, sofa, sectional or bed!

Our warm and fluffy sherpa throw blanket is made with 100% premium microfiber polyester and backed with luxurious sherpa. This sherpa blanket will keep you cozy and comfortable, day and night! Made with quality craftsmanship, this blanket makes a great gift for adults and children of all ages, for any occasion!

Every blanket is hand printed in our studio using high quality ink that fuses to the fibers of the fabric. This is a permanent printing process that is guaranteed to never crack, peel or fade. In fact, you can’t even feel it!
Easy to care for! Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry low.

Due to the nature of the melange pattern on this blanket, please allow for shade variance. Some blankets are slightly lighter/darker than others. We do our best to portray the actual color in the listing photos, color may vary from screen to screen.
If you have any questions, please message us prior to ordering. We are happy to help!
